cocApiToken1.label: Clash of Clans API token — part 1 of 3
cocApiToken1.helpText: The JWT from developer.clashofclans.com, created with 45.79.218.79 (the RoyaleAPI proxy) in its allowed IP list. Split into three because a string setting caps at 250 characters and only string settings can be secret. Part 1 starts with 'eyJ'.

cocApiToken2.label: Clash of Clans API token — part 2 of 3
cocApiToken2.helpText: Characters 201-400 of the token. Order matters.

cocApiToken3.label: Clash of Clans API token — part 3 of 3
cocApiToken3.helpText: The remainder of the token. Leave blank if the token fits in fewer parts.

discordWebhookUrl.label: Discord webhook URL
discordWebhookUrl.helpText: Where moderator notifications are sent. Point this at the private test channel until go-live, then switch it to the mod channel.

items.label: [patience-bot] Stats
items.description: How many clans and redditors the bot is tracking.

items.label: [patience-bot] Import seed data
items.description: One-time import of the old bot's history. Run until it reports complete.
